glib2.0 (2.90.1-2+stereo3d1) unstable; urgency=medium

  * Sparky Stereo OS: the location service starts again (ORDER 768).
    GLib 2.89.2 to 2.90.1 can deadlock at the first can_reach_async() of
    the netlink network monitor: a pool thread builds the default proxy
    resolver while holding default_modules_lock and waits for the GOnce
    of g_vfs_get_default(), which the main thread owns while it waits for
    that lock. geoclue then never takes its bus name and its start times
    out. This carries Thomas Hebb's upstream commit 4301b49671 unchanged
    (glib-2-90, merge request 5460; afa628dfbd on main, merge request
    5418): the proxy address enumerator is made on the calling thread and
    only the resolution stays asynchronous. GLib issue 4078 (Thomas Hebb)
    and 4047 (Julian Grinblat); merged by Philip Withnall and Emmanuele
    Bassi. Nothing else in GLib changes. Retired when Debian ships the
    commit.
    Test: tests/deadlock-reproducer (hangs on 2.90.1-2, finishes with the
    commit).
